swayable.summary: The video explains that a new postal service rule means envelopes are now postmarked at regional facilities instead of local post offices, which can delay the postmark date and cause mail-in ballots or legal documents to miss deadlines. It delivers this as a factual warning with practical tips, ending with a call to join a Patreon.
swayable.title: Your Mail-In Ballot Postmark May Now Be One Day Late
